profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Backend software engineer with 6+ years of experience specializing in scalable system design, API development, and cloud-native architecture. My experience centers on designing resilient services, improving performance, and building systems that balance extensibility, maintainability, and operational stability.

I'm known for good technical judgment, dependability, and cross-collaboration across teams to turn product goals into solid technical solutions. I also enjoy leveraging AI tooling to accelerate discovery, streamline complex workflows, and improve how ideas move from concept to execution.
